messages.content:
Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Someone sent you an unexpected gift in the post and it has arrived. Thank them.

Excited! Thanks [NAME]

Thank you [NAME], my top arrived today.
Very original and hugely appreciated, thanks [NAME].
All the very best,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: You thanked someone for a gift and have realised it was actually from a different sender. Correct it without making it awkward, and ask after the holiday they have just been on.

Hi [NAME],

I think, actually, this one was from someone else, sorry!

I'll let you know when yours arrives, haha!

Hope you had a great holiday.

Kind Regards

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: The sender confirmed a gift is still on its way to you. Acknowledge it and say you are looking forward to it.

Hi [NAME],

Glad you had a good holiday.

Can't wait for the surprise!!

All the best,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: A domain broker you buy from has offered you a domain. You cannot buy right now. Decline, but say honestly what you admired about a site of theirs, and mention you are away on holiday.

Hi [NAME],

Thank you.

I just can't just yet!

I loved your [DOMAIN] it was a really emotive image and good copy.

I'll show you some of my sites shortly, not quite as exciting I'm afraid!

Thanks [NAME], it is a fantastic domain and I would normally have grabbed it with both hands.

Am on hols at the moment in [LOCATION] and just off to the beach.

Happy times!

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Turn down another domain offer from the same broker. You are deliberately not buying at the moment. Be light about it.

It is with great regret that I must solemnly reject this wonderful offer.
If it's still around when I've sold a few ... but I very much doubt it will be!
Many thanks [NAME],
Stumped by my own brain!

Kind Regards,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Decline yet another domain offer. Very short. Keep it warm.
very nice again, thanks [NAME]. Not for me though, tempting though it was! pant pant! Kind Regards, [NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Decline a domain offer, joking that you are on a self-imposed buying ban and finding it hard.
Sorry [NAME], but strict domain diet ... You don't know how difficult it is. haha!

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: A company you deal with sent you a piece of clothing as a gift and you do not know which address to thank. Thank them and say what arrived.

Hi Team,

I'm not sure which email to write to but THANK YOU for the gift.

My sleeveless neoprene jacket / gilet / vest was great.

I really like it, thank you.

All the best,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Decline a domain offer, explaining you want to develop and sell one of the ones you already own before buying more. Acknowledge it was good value.
thanks [NAME], but not for me. I'm going to develop and sell at least one before I buy some more! Thanks for showing it - amazing value!

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: You are late replying to a domain offer. Decline for now but ask whether you can come back to them about it later.
Just seen this, sorry. That's very kind of you [NAME]. Not for now, I'll ask you again later if that's ok? That's very nice of you. Kind Regards, [NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: A recruiter has asked to put you forward for a security-focused contract. Say yes and set out your relevant experience: running your own company, managing teams, legacy and modern code, a lapsed security clearance, penetration testing project management, and a modern AI agent framework you built. Be specific about the architecture.

Hi [NAME],

I would be happy for you to represent me for [DOMAIN] which looks like a great opportunity for me to work on reducing one of the top threats of today hands on.

I have run my own company, managed small teams, and am an experienced developer. I have tackled deep and complex legacy projects just as I have modern code, and am not afraid to tackle even the most intractable looking problems.

I have had Security Clearance before when working on a project for [ORGANISATION], but it has since lapsed.

I have managed penetration testing projects in several of my previous jobs.

I am particularly strong with modern AI development having created

    an event driven,

    microservice (kubernetes, cloud) based,

    hierarchical and parallel

    containerised

    scalable

    live on production

    agent framework

    in Golang

I have created workflows for training and inference of open weight models using both CPU (inference and embeddings) and GPU and am hosting a web-browser client-side only llm model.

Skills which I hope to use to everyone's benefit in this fast-moving world that is modern development.

Kind Regards,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: That application was unsuccessful. Ask the recruiter whether there was any real feedback, so you can adjust next time.

Hi [NAME],

Was there any meaningful feedback from the client?

I'd like to know so I can adjust my approach for my next application if that's ok.

Thanks for trying.

Kind Regards,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: The recruiter has explained why there was no feedback. Accept it and wish them luck with their other candidates.

Thanks [NAME].

Sounds reasonable!

Good luck, I hope they go with one of your submissions.

Kind Regards,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Decline another domain offer. Two lines.

thanks [NAME] but not buying at the mo.

Lovely domain nonetheless.

Kind Regards,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Reply to a short friendly message about the weather. One or two lines.

yes haha, nice and cool today!

Hope you're well too.

All the best.

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Accept a domain a broker has offered you as a gift. Explain you are not developing much at the moment, reflect on how AI has changed your work — both that it makes things easy for everyone and that it makes things easier for you — and say you will pay now and that they should feel free to change their mind.

Thank you [NAME].

Yes I'd love that one please.

I am struggling to develop them at the moment so I need to stay on the diet! Hopefully soon it'll be back to business.

I am annoyed with [PRODUCT] for making everything so easy for everyone. But equally delighted that it is easier for me!

It's a dangerous world we're heading into with AI being so good.

Hoping to keep on top of it and always considering it a tool and not my master, but it is increasingly difficult to do that.

Dev jobs are becoming increasingly rare.

Anyway onwards and sideways - edit - upwards :)

I'll send money now, as always if you change your mind please just send a different domain or none at all.

Thank you [NAME].

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: A domain you were given has attracted a four-figure offer within a week. Tell the person who gave it to you.

A week later had a four figure offer lol

Brilliant!!

Thanks [NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Arrange the mechanics of a domain transfer. Give your username and email and say the DNS arrangement suits you.

Whatever is easiest for you. I guess a domain push. My username is [USERNAME]

My email is [EMAIL]

[PLATFORM] DNS is cool thank you!

Thanks again

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: The domain transfer went through. Thank them, and answer their question about your work situation honestly — you are between jobs and the market looks very different from a few years ago.

Thanks for the transfer, it worked really smoothly.

Yes, I don't have a job at the moment and will start looking again in the next month or so. It looks like a completely different landscape to when I left [EMPLOYER] three years odd ago.

Anyway, I think with a bit of effort it'll all be ok once more.

Thank you very much for the single domain.

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Reply to a friendly, joking message about your reputation and your job hunt. Match the humour. Accept an offer of another domain graciously without pressing for it.

haha!
hahaha!
yes that's a good reputation to have I think and don't want to lose it haha!
thanks for the hopefulness, I'm actually not too worried, but talk to you in a few more months time if I can still type after wearing my fingers out on all the applications.
[DOMAIN] - that is most kind and you really don't have to do it.

Thanks [NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: You have been offered a choice of two domains. Pick one, give the reason, and acknowledge the generosity.

Both brilliant - I think the [DOMAIN] because of higher value price tag of the product but I can't really choose between them!

You're being very generous, thank you.

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: A supplier has flagged a possible duplicate payment. Say you are looking into it and will come back to them.
Hi [NAME], I'm looking into it now, thanks for letting me know. There should only be one payment - from me. I will get back to you. Kind Regards, [NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Confirm you are happy to meet in person and will book a time.

Hi [NAME],

In person is fine. I'll book a slot shortly.

Thanks

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: You have booked a meeting for 9am tomorrow. Ask where to meet and say you can travel.

Hi [NAME],

Where should we meet? I've booked for 9.00 am tomorrow morning. I can travel anywhere (within reason).

Looking forward to it!

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Propose where to meet: their town is actually easier for you to drive to than the alternative, and you have coffee vouchers to use up. Offer the alternative too if it suits them better.

Hi [NAME],

I can come to [LOCATION]. It is actually quicker for me to drive there than train to [LOCATION] and it would be a whole load nicer! I've got some free [BRAND] coffee vouchers I need to use up :) unless there's a better place.

If you need to get in to [LOCATION] anyhow then that's fine too we can meet at [LOCATION]?

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Confirm a meeting place in one line.
Great, see you there!

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: The person you were meeting is unwell and has cancelled. Wish them well and make clear there is no pressure to rearrange quickly.

Hi [NAME],

Sorry to hear that.

Hope you get better soon.

Sure, we can reschedule whenever you're better, No urgency from my side.

Best of luck with it.

Kind Regards,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Rearrange the meeting: give the day, the place and the time.

Hi [NAME],

Tuesday morning would be good for me.

[BRAND] coffee, [ADDRESS] 9am Tuesday.

Look forward to it.

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: New Year message to someone you know socially. Describe your low-key New Year's Eve, note how busy they seem, and ask to be unsubscribed from a newsletter that is going to the wrong address — the social address is the right one.

Hi [NAME],

Happy New Year!

Yep we had a decent send off - stayed up to drink a glass of champagne at midnight but to be honest it was just because we were watching TV that it got so late!

Glad to see you are so busy.

Re: my email - I don't actually use this email for stuff like newsletters so please can you unsubscribe me from it. Appreciated!

[NAME]'s email is good for social stuff.

Thanks [NAME],

Hope you have a great 2026 - as good as it's looking like it's going to be at least!

Much love,

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Confirm which of your email addresses is which, respond warmly to a photo they sent, and wish them a good year.

Hi [NAME],

Yes, that's [NAME]'s email.

Nice attitude. I recognise that dinghy!

To a year of many, many such moments!

[NAME]

Write this email in my voice.

Situation: Follow up after a meeting that went well. Say so, offer to show them a tool you are building when it is ready, and offer help with their search.

Hi [NAME],

It was great to meet and talk about your plans. And the process was a pleasure!

I'd be delighted to show you the data tool once it's ready.

All the best with your search and choices and if I can help you in any way with it or other I'd be glad to do so.

Kind Regards,

[NAME]
